title: InfinityCube Resource file
description: One Resource, as the file resources/<id>.json in a Space directory (ADR 0128): the core's envelope, composed with the built-in kinds' schemas as a build registers them. The envelope names no kind; builtInKinds is the registration, one entry per kind pairing its id with its content schema. Any other well-formed kind id is a kind whose plugin is missing from the build reading the file (ADR 0142): its content is accepted as any object, which the host carries whole and never reads. Strict at both levels: the envelope refuses a top-level key it does not own, and a built-in kind refuses a key inside content it does not declare.

builtInKinds.description: The built-in kinds, as the build registers them. Adding one is one entry here, its id in the if above, and one schema under kinds/.
